title: ChipBlocks radios manifest
description: Single source of truth for radio modulation schemes available as blocks. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Each row is a synthesizable on-chip modulator that conforms to the versioned radio socket (chipblocks-radio-socket-vN). Phase 0 is an empty array; first rows (ook-433mhz, audio-fsk-bell-202) land in Sprint 31.

modulation.description: Modulation scheme. on-off-keying = OOK; fsk = frequency-shift keying; css = chirp spread spectrum (LoRa-like).

carrier_hz.description: RF carrier frequency in Hz. For audio-band modems (audio-FSK over speaker/mic) this is the audio center frequency rather than an RF carrier.

external_components.description: Bill-of-materials items external to our silicon (antenna, RF transistor, balun, crystal, etc.).

bom_cost_usd.description: Approximate cost of the external-components total in USD.

range_meters.description: Approximate range in meters under typical conditions.

block_path.description: Path to the synthesizable Amaranth modulator block (e.g. 'backend/radios/ook_433mhz.py').
